title: Blockchain Wallets in One Minute
sourceTitle: An original explainer on blockchain wallets

scenes.title: A window onto the chain
scenes.narration: A wallet looks like a pocket for money. A self-custody wallet manages your keys. Your asset records stay on the blockchain.
scenes.sourceQuote: A wallet looks like a pocket for money. A self-custody wallet manages your keys. Your asset records stay on the blockchain.

props.title: A wallet: your window onto the chain

scenes.title: Address and key: separate jobs
scenes.narration: An address is a mailbox you can share. A key is a signing pen only you should hold. Knowing an address doesn’t give control.
scenes.sourceQuote: An address is a mailbox you can share. A key is a signing pen only you should hold. Knowing an address doesn’t give control.

scenes.title: Which road are you on?
scenes.narration: Think of two networks as two roads. Sender and receiver must pick the same one. Networks A and B here are just examples.
scenes.sourceQuote: Think of two networks as two roads. Sender and receiver must pick the same one. Networks A and B here are just examples.

props.title: First, check which road you’re on
props.networkNote: Two separate roads, no shortcut between them

scenes.title: One transfer, three gates
scenes.narration: First, check network, address and details. Then sign with your key to authorize it. Records update once the network confirms.
scenes.sourceQuote: First, check network, address and details. Then sign with your key to authorize it. Records update once the network confirms.

scenes.title: New device, same control
scenes.narration: A backup helps you regain control. Never send your seed phrase as a screenshot. Guarding the backup means guarding the key.
scenes.sourceQuote: A backup helps you regain control. Never send your seed phrase as a screenshot. Guarding the backup means guarding the key.

props.title: New device? Get your control back
props.backupNote: Sample card · no real seed phrase
props.backupWarning: Never hand your key to anyone.

scenes.title: Remember these three places
scenes.narration: Addresses receive, and keys sign. Wallets act, and records stay on-chain. Tell them apart, and you know your wallet.
scenes.sourceQuote: Addresses receive, and keys sign. Wallets act, and records stay on-chain. Tell them apart, and you know your wallet.
